citations.assessment: The cross-referenced article explicitly records the contrasting Aḥa bar Abba reading of this very report.

holds.reason: The form “the Arab” is attested and the visit establishes a locality. Heilprin’s more specific place-of-residence gloss is retained separately from the exact wording of the cited text.
